project.description: Daily Belarus holiday check and official exchange rates

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/sh set -eu
TODAY="$(date +%F)" YEAR="$(date +%Y)"
echo "Date: ${TODAY}" echo "=== Belarus holiday check ==="
HOLIDAYS="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error "https://tallyfy.com/national-holidays/api/BY/${YEAR}.json")" HOLIDAY_NAME="$(printf '%s' "${HOLIDAYS}" | jq -r --arg today "${TODAY}" '.holidays[]? | select(.date == $today) | .name' | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "${HOLIDAY_NAME}" ]; then echo "Today is a public holiday in Belarus: ${HOLIDAY_NAME}" else echo "Today is not a public holiday in Belarus." fi
echo "=== National Bank of Belarus exchange rates ===" RATES="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error 'https://api.nbrb.by/exrates/rates?periodicity=0')"
for CODE in USD EUR RUB; do printf '%s' "${RATES}" | jq -r --arg code "${CODE}" '.[] | select(.Cur_Abbreviation == $code) | "\(.Cur_Scale) \(.Cur_Abbreviation) = \(.Cur_OfficialRate) BYN"' done
